ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a large outer triangle, with the lower-left end denoted as A, the vertex denoted as B, and the lower-right end denoted as E. There is a point C on the base AE, and a line segment is drawn downward from B to C. Another slanted line is drawn from C to a point D on the right side BE. Then reason: Count according to the triangles formed by the drawn line segments: on the left there is triangle ABC; in the middle there is triangle BCD; on the lower right there is triangle CDE; on the right there is the larger triangle BCE; finally there is also the whole outer triangle ABE. There is no line segment from A to D, nor any other additional closed three-sided figure. Therefore there are 5 triangles in total.

method.method_draft: First describe and label the diagram: identify the large outer triangle with left base point A, apex B, right base point E; note an interior segment from B down to a base point C; note another interior segment from C up to a point D on the right sloping side BE. Then enumerate all triangles whose three sides lie on drawn segments: triangle ABC on the left; triangle BCD in the middle; triangle CDE on the lower right; the larger right triangle BCE; and the whole outer triangle ABE. Count these five and stop, checking that no other closed three-sided regions are formed because there are no drawn segments from A to D or A to any point on BE besides B/E.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个大的外三角形，左下端记为 A，顶点记为 B，右下端记为 E。底边 AE 上有一点 C，从 B 向下画了一条线段到 C。又从 C 画了一条斜线到右侧边 BE 上的一点 D。
再推理：按已画出的线段组成三角形来数：左侧有三角形 ABC；中间有三角形 BCD；右下有三角形 CDE；右侧较大的三角形 BCE；最后还有整个外三角形 ABE。没有从 A 到 D 的线段，也没有其他额外闭合三边形。因此共有 5 个三角形。
